requirement.description: {reliability_ruth} suggested implementing continuous monitoring of real-world performance to identify and report issues. She wants the canary and A/B testing to be automated to catch performance regressions immediately.
requirement.fact: {reliability_ruth} suggested implementing continuous monitoring of real-world performance to identify and report issues.
requirement.reading: She wants the canary and A/B testing to be automated to catch performance regressions immediately.

speaker.name: Reliability Ruth
speaker.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.objection: You are treating my request for automated canary and A/B testing as a simple monitoring feature, but I need a full feedback loop for immediate regression detection. Without that automation, my team cannot guarantee the reliability of the live services.
output.correction: I did not ask for a general performance dashboard, I specifically requested automated testing workflows to catch regressions before they hit users. Please reclassify this as a requirement for automated deployment gates, not just passive monitoring.
